recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The Published issue has already been applied and preserved through the HTTP/Search page refactor; no further core source work is needed for FHIR-38745.
issue_request: FHIR-38745 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked to add a GET-based compartment search example to the search HTTP GET table and to keep or clarify the note about the old URL being indistinguishable from a read; the final resolution instead said that statement was not true, should be dropped, and compartment search examples should be added.
initial_application: Commit 72539afe56e743824da8f6b8d6e71f33c908dc71 applied the issue by replacing the old source/search.html row that said compartment search was unavailable because it was indistinguishable from READ with two GET compartment-search examples: [compartment-id]/* for all compartment resource types and [compartment-id]/[resource-type] for a specific type.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-10-24 corroborate the Persuasive with Modification vote. Later commit e441170220c19e992f803667b245e63dcdd508cf for FHIR-39137 moved the detailed HTTP POST/GET search protocol examples from source/search.html to source/http.html. The current hierarchy and documentation index include both http.html and search.html, so the checked source is in current build scope. Zulip/Jira/Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision for this issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/http.html contains the all-contained-resource-types and specific-resource-type GET compartment examples, and current source/search.html notes that '*' is valid as [type] in GET-based compartment searches to disambiguate a read from a compartment search. The removed false statement is absent from the current search and HTTP source.

related_jiras.note: This later refactor moved HTTP search protocol content from source/search.html to source/http.html, explaining why the FHIR-38745 examples now live on the HTTP page.
